title: retail-service test fails: killed_service_resumes_original_resource_task_and_settlement
body: `crates/retail-service/tests/process.rs::killed_service_resumes_original_resource_task_and_settlement` fails with "live accounting changed since the checkpoint". Seen 2026-10-09 while building ENV-10 (#11006, 11aa37dd44); it still fails with ENV-10's two new pieces turned off, so it looks older. Find the cause and fix it.
